_comment: Each member is invoked once per round in an EMPTY ephemeral temp directory.
Placeholders: {prompt} = full self-contained prompt, {cwd} = the temp workdir,
{outfile} = <cwd>/answer.md (only used by members that set answer_file),
{model} and {thinking} = the member fields of the same name.
{model}/{thinking} are OPTIONAL: if the field is null or empty, that argv element and
the flag immediately before it are both dropped, so the tool falls back to its own
default. A literal "" in argv (claude --tools) is NOT a placeholder and is kept.
Every prompt is fully self-contained, so members need no file or network access.
Flags are chosen to strip each tool's local config so the panel starts symmetric:
claude --safe-mode  -> ignores CLAUDE.md, skills, plugins, hooks, MCP
which is why codex model and reasoning effort MUST be set explicitly here.
Inspect or change all of this with: consensus.py models [--set id.field=value]
Override per problem by adding a "panel" key to that problem's config.json.

tuning.model_hint: opus | sonnet | haiku | fable, or a full model id
a Codex model id, e.g. gpt-5.6-sol
a Gemini model id; null uses the CLI default
tuning.isolation: headless -p (tools needing approval are unavailable); empty workdir. No flag to skip ~/.gemini/settings.json or ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md
